_note: Context cards shown alongside book-code questions. Never quizzed. match: [chapter, sections this card covers].

cases.title: World population estimates
cases.about: UN estimates of world population (in thousands) for each decade from 1950 to 2010.

cases.title: Résumé field experiment
cases.about: Researchers sent fictitious résumés to real job ads, randomly varying only the applicant's first name to signal race and sex. Unit: one résumé.

vars.race: black or white (signaled by the name)

frames.resume: one fictitious résumé sent to an employer

cases.title: Social pressure GOTV experiment
cases.about: Registered voters were randomly assigned to receive one of three get-out-the-vote mailings or no mailing (Control) before a primary election. Unit: one voter.

vars.messages: group: Civic Duty, Control, Hawthorne, Neighbors

cases.title: Minimum-wage study
cases.about: New Jersey raised its minimum wage from $4.25 to $5.05; neighboring Pennsylvania did not. Fast-food restaurants in both states were surveyed before and after. Unit: one restaurant.

vars.location: centralNJ, northNJ, shoreNJ, southNJ, or PA
vars.wageBefore / wageAfter: hourly wage before / after the increase
vars.fullBefore / fullAfter: number of full-time employees before / after
vars.partBefore / partAfter: number of part-time employees before / after

cases.title: Afghanistan survey
cases.about: A survey of male respondents in southern Afghanistan during the war, measuring demographics, civilian victimization, and support for combatants (via a list experiment). Unit: one respondent.

vars.violent.exp.ISAF: 1 = respondent or family harmed by foreign forces (ISAF)
vars.list.group: randomly assigned list: control, ISAF, or taliban
vars.list.response: number of list items the respondent supports (0-4)

cases.title: Afghan villages
cases.about: All villages in the survey region, sampled or not. Unit: one village.

frames.afghan.village: one village in the survey region

cases.title: Congressional ideal points
cases.about: DW-NOMINATE ideal-point estimates for House members, 80th-112th Congresses. Negative = liberal, positive = conservative. Unit: one legislator in one Congress. USGini.csv holds the US Gini coefficient by year.

vars.gini (USGini): Gini coefficient of income inequality for that year

frames.rep: one Republican legislator in one Congress
frames.dem: one Democratic legislator in one Congress

cases.title: 2008 presidential polls
cases.about: State election results and pre-election polls for 2008, plus national polls. Unit: a state (results) or a poll (polls).

vars.middate: middle date of the poll's fieldwork

cases.title: Facial competence experiment
cases.about: Subjects saw pairs of candidate photos for under a second and judged which looked more competent; the ratings are compared with actual election results. Unit: one congressional race.

vars.d.votes / r.votes: votes for the Democratic / Republican candidate
vars.d.comp / r.comp: share of subjects judging the Democrat / Republican more competent
vars.diff.share: created: Democratic minus Republican two-party vote share

cases.title: 2008 and 2012 state results
cases.about: State-level presidential results for 2008 and 2012. Unit: one state.

frames.pres: one state, with its 2008 and 2012 results merged

cases.title: Florida counties, 1996 and 2000
cases.about: County-level presidential votes in Florida. Palm Beach used the confusing 'butterfly ballot' in 2000. Unit: one county.

cases.title: Women as policy makers
cases.about: In India, one-third of village council head seats (at the Gram Panchayat level) were randomly reserved for women. Unit: one village.

vars.reserved: 1 = the GP's seat was reserved for a woman (treatment)
vars.female: 1 = the GP had a female leader

cases.title: Social pressure GOTV experiment
cases.about: Registered voters randomly assigned to one of three mailings or none (Control). Unit: one voter.

vars.messages: group: Civic Duty (base level), Control, Hawthorne, Neighbors

cases.title: MPs' wealth (regression discontinuity)
cases.about: British parliamentary candidates who narrowly won or lost, and their wealth at death. Unit: one candidate.

vars.margin.pre: the party's margin in the previous election (placebo outcome)
